text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed on 
 yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mamdouh Aly Hassan, accepted by 
 general director eng. Nagy Nageeb Saleh, and approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
 Bast head Sector of Aswan Dam 2 Hydraulic Power Station and certified by eng. 
 Kamel Ragheb: HPGC MPIS coordinator.
A 
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the Personal safety and healthy protective equipment as safety shoes, 
 helmet ,. Etc.
The distribution boards must be 
 isolated voltage from two sides ( IN OUT ).
Safety helmet, safety belt etc
Megger.
Hand tools.
Voltage indicator.
Digital voltmeter
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
By using compressed dry air, remove dust and pollution from bus bars, CB and 
 cabinet.
Check all power cables, bus bars bolts fitting.
Check all insulation parts and change it when necessary.
Check the earthing for boards and good tighten.
Change any wires not good.
Meggring between distribution board parts and ground.
